crossRefs.note: “You shall make the altar of acacia wood, five cubits long, and five cubits wide. The altar shall be square. Its height…
He made the altar of burnt offering of acacia wood. It was square. Its length was five cubits, its width was five…
“Behold, I have called by name Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, of the tribe of Judah.
Azubah died, and Caleb married Ephrath, who bore him Hur.
Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

parallels.note: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezalel.

people.name: Bezalel
people.line: Skilled craftsman who built the tabernacle

people.name: Hur
people.line: A companion of Moses and grandfather of Bezalel.

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

people.name: Uri
people.line: Father of Bezalel, the skilled craftsman

translations.web: Moreover the bronze altar that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made was there before Yahweh’s tabernacle; and Solomon and the assembly were seeking counsel there.
translations.bsb: But the bronze altar made by Bezalel son of Uri, the son of Hur, was in Gibeon before the tabernacle of the LORD. So Solomon and the assembly inquired of Him there.
translations.kjv: Moreover the brasen altar, that Bezaleel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, he put before the tabernacle of the LORD: and Solomon and the congregation sought unto it.
translations.asv: Moreover the brazen altar, that Bezalel the son of Uri, the son of Hur, had made, was there before the tabernacle of Jehovah: and Solomon and the assembly sought unto it.
